study.name: Phase 2b: H7 Temperature — Track 2 (brief-text)
study.description:
Tests 5 temperature levels at the best text-only M/E from Phase 2a
(brief-text, F1=0.5425). This track explores whether text-only
performance varies with temperature — particularly whether lower
temperatures improve precision (brief-text had P=0.43, R=0.72 at T=1.0).

Dual-track context: brief-text unexpectedly outperformed all image-using
conditions in Phase 2a, but no pairwise differences survived FDR correction.
This track runs in parallel with the image-using track (brief-text-image)
and maintains independent optimal parameters. See Decision 16.

Text-only prompts have a substantially smaller context window (no base64
images), which may cause different temperature sensitivity compared to the
image-using track.
